scope: formal scenario head runtime type, field consumers, resource bindings and city color snapshot

evidence.formal_inventory: All 20 formal scenarios use an 82-byte head; format/version, IDs, dates and dimensions close exactly.
evidence.world_flags: head +0x04..+0x13 load four u32 words into the 128-bit ScenarioWorldState flag store; date finalization ORs fixed bits into the first word.
evidence.packed_field: The loader widens the low byte to land_draw_cache_code and masks the high byte to a four-bit scenario_mode_code; the former is the sole D_Land%1d%1d.s9 cache filename selector.
evidence.city_colors: Across 1,000 formal city slots, all 798 valid slots equal the owning force record ColorCode and all 202 empty slots equal 0xFF.
evidence.resource_binding: Formal scenario title and description use M_MsgPK message IDs 2*ScenarioId and 2*ScenarioId+1; text is generated at runtime and is not serialized in head.

verification.type_readback: San9ScenarioHeaderRuntime size 528 with expected field offsets
verification.decompiler_readback: deserialize_scenario_head uses the recovered field names
